submitted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.customer c JOIN public.invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;
validated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.customer AS c JOIN public.invoice AS i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1
